source_note: H1 2026 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47488_AFRICA_PRUDENTIAL_PLC-_QUARTER_2_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2026_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_JULY_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. | AUDIT 2026-10-04 (net-profit accuracy): the H1 2026 net profit was WITHHELD (set to null). This statement is stored in NGN '000 (the filing's printed unit), not absolute units, so the value renders 1000x too small under the platform's absolute convention. The audit rule requires the cell to equal the discovery record's profit_after_tax with the unit applied (absolute 1588902000); per fix-only-by-withholding it was nulled rather than rescaled. NOTE: the whole statement (revenue and every other row of this file) is stored in NGN '000 and needs block normalisation.
